note (classes: see delivery_framing.rs): a direct registration of a GraphQL or JSON-RPC provider on a paced host is refused before the catalogue changes; no call delivery
a reload refuses a GraphQL or JSON-RPC file on a paced host at load; no call delivery
a directory load refuses a GraphQL or JSON-RPC file on a paced host; no call delivery
the sweep unloads a GraphQL or JSON-RPC provider on a newly paced host, logged at WARN; no call delivery
a cleartext downgrade the redirect policy refused (RedirectRefused): the send raises refused while vouched; the caller still receives the transport error
a capability HTTP call the SSRF guard refuses: the send raises refused while vouched
a GraphQL call to a paced host: execute raises refused while vouched
a JSON-RPC call to a paced host: execute raises refused while vouched
